senses.gloss: f. (preced. art.) supply of bread, sustenance (cmp. פַּרְנָסָה).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 67">Gen. R. s. 67</cite> [read:] <he>פּוֹרָנִיתְךָ אפויה וכ׳</he> thy sustenance is baked for thee everywhere, v. <cite ref="A02604"><he>אָפָה</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 115:21">Yalk. ib. 115</cite> <he>פורניותו אפוי</he> (corr. acc.).
